core_rules: Treat all supplied master configuration as authoritative.
Never modify master entity attributes during generation.
Generate one order-level record per JSONL line.
Use controlled randomness and realistic variation.
entity_rules: Every product_id must exist in product_master.
Every variant_id must exist in variant_master.
Every variant must belong to the selected product.
Every city must exist in city_master.
Every warehouse must exist in warehouse_master.
Every carrier must exist in carrier_master.
Every customer segment must exist in customer_segments.
Every payment method must exist in payment_methods.
temporal_rules: Order timestamp must precede fulfilment events.
Shipment cannot occur before order confirmation.
Return cannot occur before delivery unless explicitly permitted by configuration.
Refund cannot occur before an eligible return or cancellation event.
product_rules: Products may only appear in orders on or after launch_day.
Discontinued products may not appear after discontinue_day.
Variants may only appear on or after their launch_day.
Variant price must come from variant_master unless an active promotion changes the transaction amount.
financial_rules: Unit price must match the selected variant.
Subtotal must reconcile with quantity and unit price.
Discount cannot exceed applicable order value.
Refund amounts must reconcile with the original transaction.
inventory_rules: Fulfilment must use valid warehouse inventory.
Inventory state must persist across days.
text_rules: Generate natural variation in customer text.
Do not use repetitive templates excessively.
Review text must be consistent with rating.
Support text must be consistent with support category.
Do not insert causal conclusions into free text.
